description: This file contains a Kotlin class StubAnalyticsHelper implementing the AnalyticsHelper interface, used as a stub to log analytics events to Logcat in Android development. It provides a simple logging mechanism for analytics events during development or testing.

classes.name: StubAnalyticsHelper
classes.description: A singleton class that provides a stub implementation of AnalyticsHelper, logging analytics events to Logcat instead of sending them to a backend.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs the received AnalyticsEvent to Logcat with debug level.
